checks.result: 1h/12h/20h of unpaid AFK at the chapter-1 rate pay 3600/43200/43200 gold (12h cap, excess discarded); Story/Tower progress is unchanged and nothing is paid before reward.claim.
farm.claim reserves once; a replay of the same interval returns NO_FARM_ELAPSED with state unchanged and a stale cursor is rejected without moving reserved_through back.
An online 30-minute reservation and a later 17.5h AFK window are disjoint; the AFK part alone is capped at 43200 and crossing Bangkok midnight does not reset the farm clock.
The pure reserveFarm with an injected clock equals the server farm.claim settlement exactly (pending claims and farm cursor); four 500ms reservations keep 2 gold at 3600/h through integer carries.

A content patch does not rewrite the stored rate snapshot; a farm stage change settles the old interval at the frozen rate first, and the same request id reproduces the same reservation. One TS calculator, no SQL formula.

limitations: The AFK report UI is the existing farm sheet/chest (TASK-048); no separate AFK screen was added.
